elena (pm): Quick thread to align on the v2 API migration playbook. Need concrete launch gates, a lightweight migration CLI, and a customer-facing coexistence policy. Short takes?

ved (eng): From infra: header opt-in is easiest: `X-RW-API: 2`. But running dual codepaths will require a per-customer cache namespace to avoid KV collisions. That adds ~15% mem for hot customers.

marc (solutions): Customer impact matrix we should publish: 
- offline-index embeddings: small vector drift changes ranking, must run local reindexing.
- strict tool-call parsers: exact field names break, usually fixable with a shim.
- chat with long context windows: different tokenization/segmentation can shift prefix caching.
We'll provide per-case remediation steps.

tara (sre): Canary gating suggestion (automated):
- perf: p95 delta <= +18% vs v1 baseline
- availability: error-rate < 0.5% per hour
- quality: regression detector on canonical prompt sets; block if failing rate >1.5%
- embedding drift: mean cosine drop < 1.3%
If any gate trips, auto-block and page on-call.

ian (sales): Customers will want a clear coexistence window. Recommend 90 days optional coexistence after GA for self-serve, 6-12 months for enterprise SLAs. Need a one-pager sales brief.

elena (pm): Proposed acceptance checklist for canary->prod:
1) Embeddings: anchor mean cosine drop < 1.2% and top-20 recall delta < 1%
2) Chat: automated scorer pass + 75 human spot checks across failure clusters < 2% regression
3) Tool-calls: golden integration tests pass; unmapped fields logged as warnings
4) Perf: sustained throughput >= 80% of baseline under representative load
5) Observability: per-customer traces + hourly synthetic runs
Agree or adjust?

ved (eng): Agree with numbers. Implementation notes: SDKs default to opt-out (no header) to prevent surprises. Provide `redwood.migrate.enable()` helper for gradual opt-in. We'll also emit `X-RW-MIGRATE-WARN` when shims drop fields.

marc (solutions): For tool-calls we should publish a mapping table and an example shim repo. Example mapping: v2 `{"tool_id":"calc","args":{}}` -> v1 `{"tool":{"name":"calc","params":{}}}`. Customers can run a `--dry-run` first.

tara (sre): Canary rollout stages suggestion: internal smoke (48h) -> invited pilots (2 weeks) -> opt-in beta (4 weeks). Each stage requires telemetry green for 48h before progressing. Ops-bot will gate progression.

elena (pm): Migration CLI idea: `rw-migrate check --prompts prompts.json --mode dry` and `rw-migrate run --goldens goldens/`. Keep it intentionally minimal. It should emit a short JSON summary and human-readable report.

ian (sales): Add a quick risk indicator to the one-pager: low/medium/high engineering effort for each change. Helps set customer expectations.

legal: Reminder: if customers upload real production prompts for evaluation, we need a DPA addendum. We have a template; legal@redwood will circulate it.

ved (eng): Timeline ask: 7 weeks to ship headers+SDK bits, shims, basic CLI, and canary infra. If product wants to shorten, we limit to opt-in header only (no shims).

elena (pm): Draft timeline: week 0-2 headers + docs + SDK helpers, week 3-5 shims + CLI + compatibility tests, week 6 internal canary + pilot invites, week 7-9 pilots and review. Deprecation policy draft: announce v1 sunset at GA + 12 months, final enforced sunset GA + 24 months; enterprise extensions available.

marc (solutions): I'll assemble per-customer golden tests and the mapping docs. Will deliver initial set by Fri.

tara (sre): I'll own dashboards and synthetic runners. Will also add per-customer rate-limited alerts to avoid alert fatigue.

elena (pm): Action items: marc: golden tests + mapping by Fri; ved: engineering estimate + opt-in plan by Mon; tara: dashboards + synthetic jobs by Mon; legal: DPA template circulation. I'll draft the one-pager for sales and share.

ian (sales): Good. We'll line up 3 pilot customers and send the outreach once the one-pager is ready.

elena (pm): Thanks team. I'll post a follow-up with the initial PR for the playbook and migration CLI spec. Staying flexible on dates if engineering needs scope reduction. :white_check_mark:
